title: Untagged follow-up preference defaults to NEVER (opt-in), creator's setting governs thread
answers: What is the default when untagged_followup_mode is unset?
Whose follow-up preference applies in a Slack thread?
body:
`resolve_untagged_followup_mode` in products/slack_app/backend/services/slack_settings.py returns `UntaggedFollowupMode.NEVER` when no slack_user_id, no SlackSettings row, NULL column, or unrecognised value. So follow-ups are opt-in per person.
Choices: `UntaggedFollowupMode` (auto/ask/never) in models.py; column `SlackSettings.untagged_followup_mode`.
The mode is read from the thread creator (`mapping.mentioning_slack_user_id`) and applies to everyone replying in that thread. Lookup is per (workspace, user) personal row only; no workspace-wide NULL-user fallback for this setting.
`never` acts at the webhook (`_untagged_followups_switched_off`); ask/auto act in the workflow. Confirmed runs re-check that the creator has not switched off.
